entries.# …: A heading; from # to ###### for six levels.
entries.…\n===: An underlined heading: === for the first level, --- for the second.
entries.- …: A bulleted list; * and + work too.
entries.1. …: A numbered list; the first number sets the start.
entries.␣␣- …: A nested list, indented under its parent item.
entries.- [ ] …: A task list: [ ] to do, [x] done.
entries.[…](url \"…\"): A link with a title, shown on hover.
entries.https://…: A bare address, turned into a link.
entries.[…][ref]: A reference link, its address defined elsewhere in the text.
entries.![…](url): An image, with its alternative text.
entries.`…`: Inline code; ``…`` when it holds a backtick itself.
entries.```lang: A code block, with its language for highlighting; ~~~ works too.
entries.␣␣␣␣…: A code block, by an indentation of four spaces.
entries.---: A horizontal rule; *** and ___ too, between blank lines.
entries.| … |: A table; the second line separates the header from the rest.
entries.…␣␣: A line break inside a paragraph: two spaces at the end of the line.
entries.…\\: A line break inside a paragraph: a backslash at the end of the line.
entries.<tag>: HTML in the middle of the text; GitHub filters some of it.
entries.[^1]: A footnote, sent to the end of the document.
